question: Should Android expose ClawHub skill search/install review plus a read-scoped explicit `skills.securityVerdicts.items` lookup while install/update enforcement stays in Gateway admin methods?
rationale: Automation can verify the admin gating and bounded schema shape, but deciding whether read-scoped clients may request pre-install verdicts for slug/version pairs is a product and security-boundary choice.

options.title: Accept After Fix And Proof
options.body: Require the ktlint fix and successful exact-head Android proof, then accept the bounded server-controlled verdict lookup because install/update still require admin-gated Gateway methods.

options.title: Narrow The Verdict API
options.body: Keep Android management work but remove or further restrict explicit verdict lookups if read-scoped clients should not request arbitrary slug/version verdicts.

options.title: Defer Android Installs
options.body: Pause this PR if Android should remain inspection-only until maintainers sponsor a broader skills-management direction.

recommendation.title: Accept After Fix And Proof
recommendation.body: Require the ktlint fix and successful exact-head Android proof, then accept the bounded server-controlled verdict lookup because install/update still require admin-gated Gateway methods.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent overlap across Android runtime, Gateway skills, protocol, and ClawHub-related boundary work.
